answer: In this PoA design, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of good behavior. EigenTrust factorization propagates trust through established, reciprocal edges; freshly spawned sybil identities therefore begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus, even if they echo a sonnet, emit a persuasive signal, or wear a velvet label.
